decision_cards.future_trap: Cheapest option; good if water/power are tight, but low food supply for Ares-2 crew.
Balanced choice if you only have 2 days left (1 day potatoes + 1 day fitness).
Boosts immunity before isolation crisis (Sol 24), but requires solid water reserves.

scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: Mars gravity is only 38% of Earth's, causing astronauts' muscles and bones to weaken rapidly without daily resistance exercise.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: NASA uses special blue LED lighting (Circadian Lighting) to regulate astronauts' biological clocks and sleep cycles in the absence of natural Earth light.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_3: Closed greenhouse plants produce fresh oxygen and food while absorbing carbon dioxide, just like the Veggie experiment on the ISS.
